facts.material: electro-optical instrument (light source, high-speed camera, electronics, software)
facts.function: measures particle size and shape distribution by imaging falling particles (dynamic image analysis)
facts.end_use: quality control of dry, pourable bulk materials (powders, granules)

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9027 covers instruments and apparatus for physical or chemical analysis; particle size (granulometric) analysis is physical analysis
Section XVI note 1(m) excludes chapter 90 instruments from chapter 84/85

GRI 6: 9027.50 other instruments using optical radiations (visible light imaging); electrical (chapter 90 additional U.S. note 2), 9027.50.40; not chemical, thermal or a photometer, so suffix 60 other

rejected_alternatives.reason: optical measuring or checking instruments not elsewhere specified; 9027 more specifically covers apparatus for physical analysis such as particle size analysis
other analysis instruments not using optical radiation; the analyzer works by optical imaging
chemical analysis; particle size/shape is physical analysis
not an automatic data processing machine; excluded as a chapter 90 instrument

classification.rationale: A dynamic image analyzer determines particle size and shape of bulk powders and granules, which is physical analysis within heading 9027. It works by illuminating particles and capturing images with a camera, so it is an instrument using optical radiation of 9027.50, and being electrical it goes to 9027.50.40. As it is not a chemical or thermal analyzer or photometer, the statistical line is 9027.50.40.60 (other). No ruling on this exact instrument was found.
